sources.title: Steam Community Guide: Wurm Unlimited GM Commands
ago1024/WurmServerModLauncher (server mod launcher and bundled mod set)
Wurm Unlimited Dedicated Server - AppID 402370 - SteamDB

notes: No remote command channel. The stock dedicated server (WurmServerLauncher, Steam app 402370, a Tool-type app distinct from the game app 366220) is administered through a Java Swing GUI whose tabs are Select Game Database, Local Server, Server Neighbors, Server Travel and Players; the Players tab is where an operator moves a player, sets power level, or bans. Wurmpedia describes the ADMINPWD setting as "adminpwd=<password> Unlocks the admin commands from within the game" - i.e. the # commands (#kick <playername>, #ban <playername> <days> <reason>, #pardon <playername>, #who, #broadcast, #announce, #showbans, syntax per the Steam GM Commands guide) are typed into chat by a logged-in character holding GM power, not sent to the server process. They are therefore not reachable from a server manager and are deliberately NOT recorded as commands here. No RCON listener, no admin HTTP/REST API, and no documented stdin command set; Wurmpedia's headless recipe is just "./WurmServerLauncher start=<ServerFolder>", which launches the server without the GUI and adds no console vocabulary. RMI IS NOT ADMIN: the launcher takes rmiport= and rmiregport= and Wurmpedia discusses Java RMI, but that is server-to-server login/travel federation between Wurm servers, not a moderation interface a manager can drive. DISAGREEMENT: the CubeCoders AMP template sets App.AdminMethod=STDIO and App.HasWriteableConsole=True, which implies a writable stdin, but the same template also uses App.ExitMethod=OS_CLOSE and leaves Console.UserActions={} empty - i.e. AMP itself defines no kick/ban/say console action for this game - and no Wurm-side console command vocabulary is documented anywhere; Mthec's third-party launcher adds its own text "Server Console Menu" (help/menu/list/up/select/shutdown), which the stock launcher does not have, and ago1024's standard server mod set (Announcer, BagOfHolding, CreatureAgeMod, CropMod, HarvestHelper, InbreedWarning, ServerPacks, SpellMod) ships no RCON or remote-admin mod. Confidence is low because this is a negative claim: several independent sources are consistent with "no command channel", but none states outright that RCON is absent. No plain-text ban file is documented (bans live in the server's SQLite databases), so no banList is recorded.
